models_evaluated: AI-assisted lung ultrasound model for absent lung sliding

links.outcome: Real-time prospective diagnostic accuracy of AI-LUS for absent lung sliding versus expert consensus
links.effect: Sensitivity 0.921 (95% CI 0.792-0.973), specificity 0.802 (0.735-0.856), AUC 0.885, accuracy 0.824; high sensitivity but moderate specificity in live bedside use.
links.quote: AI-LUS showed a sensitivity of 0.921 (95% CI, 0.792-0.973), specificity of 0.802 (95% CI, 0.735-0.856), area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.885 (95% CI, 0.828-0.956), and accuracy of 0.824 (95% CI, 0.766-0.870) for the diagnosis of absent lung sliding.

screen.reason: Prospective diagnostic accuracy study evaluating a real-time AI lung ultrasound model for detecting absent lung sliding at the bedside in patients with suspected pneumothorax.
